title: Best Black Friday Audio Deals 2026: Save Up to 60% Off Bose, Apple & Beats, Sonos, Sony & More Online
summary: Shop the best Black Friday headphones, earbuds, soundbars, turntables and other audio deals — save up to 60% off the top brands.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Black Friday is the best time of the year for shopping for gifts for friends and family, thanks to deep discounts that are only available for a limited time. If you want to get all of your holiday shopping finished for cheap, now is the time to shop, especially on audio tech and gear .

With savings up to 60% off list prices, Shop Billboard rounded up the best audio deals on all sorts of earbuds, headphones, wireless speakers, turntables and other gear. We included discounts on top brands, like Apple, Beats by Dre, Sony, Samsung, Bose and others.

LOWEST PRICE EVER

Apple AirPods Pro 3

$149.00 $249.00 40% off

Buy Now On Amazon

On sale for $149 (was $249), the Apple AirPods Pro 3 are the tech company’s top-tier wireless earbuds with best-in-class noise-canceling features that are housed in a sleek and stylish design. At 40% off their list price, this is the cheapest price we’ve ever seen on these premium earbuds.

Beats 360 Wireless Over-Ear Headphones

$249.00 $349.99 29% off

Just released in September, the Beats 360 Wireless Over-Ear Headphones are on sale for $249 (was $349) on Amazon. These are the latest and greatest headphones from Beats by Dre with rich, textured and robust audio, as well as customizable earbuds for style and personalization. At nearly 30% off, this is the lowest price ever on these headphones.

Sony WH-CH520 Wireless On-Ear Bluetooth Headphones

$28.00 $69.99 60% off

Marked down to just $28 (was $69.99), Sony WH-CH520 Wireless On-Ear Bluetooth Headphones are on sale for the cheapest price we’ve ever seen. That’s 60% off the list price and the lowest price ever on these excellent entry-level headphones.

Nothing Ear (a) Wireless Earbuds

$55.00 $79.00 30% off

The Nothing Ear (a) Wireless Earbuds , which are on sale for $55 (was $79), are a sleek and stylish pair of noise-canceling earbuds that come in three colors: yellow (pictured above), black and white. The design makes them pop, while their long battery life of up to 42 hours per charge gives users longevity. Plus, these earbuds are noise-canceling for peace and quiet.

Marshall Emberton II Portable Speaker

$89.99 $179.99 50% off

This classic Marshall Emberton II Portable Speaker is a must-give for music lovers, whole it’s on sale for $89.99 (was $179.99) on Amazon. The Bluetooth speaker boasts the audio company’s signature sound that’s multi-directional, rich and detailed. At 50% off, this is the deepest discount we’ve seen on this speaker model.

Sony S100F 2.0ch Soundbar

$98.00 $159.99 39% off

Instead of turning up the volume on a TV, get the Sony S100F 2.0ch Soundbar that completely enhances audio from movies and TV shows. And since it’s compact and sleek, the soundbar is best for bedrooms and small living rooms. It’s on sale for $98 (was $159.99) on Amazon.

SteelSeries Arctis Nova 5 Wireless Gaming Headset

$99.99 $149.99 33% off

For the gamer in your life, the SteelSeries Arctis Nova 5 Wireless Gaming Headset , which is on sale for $99.99 (was $149.99), is ideal to enhance video games with detailed sound, thanks to impressive high-fidelity audio, advanced noise-cancelation and comfy all-day fit. It comes in white and black too.

Technics Hi-Fi True Wireless Earbuds

$99.99 $199.99 50% off

For audiophiles, you can save 50% off the Technics Hi-Fi True Wireless Earbuds , which are a pair of premium earbuds that deliver reference-quality audio. These earbuds feature masterfully-crafted 10mm dynamic drivers for deep and rich sound. They’re on sale for $99.99 (was $199.99), which is the earbuds’ cheapest price ever.

Sony PULSE Explore Wireless Earbuds

$119.00 $199.99 40% off

On sale for $119 (was $199.99), which is the all-time lowest price ever, the Sony PULSE Explore Wireless Earbuds are a pair of true wireless earbuds specifically designed for the PS5, PS5 Pro and PS5 Portal. These accessories offer excellent gaming audio that’s crisp, full and immersive with deep and rumbling bass. It comes with a USB dongle that plugs directly into the back of the console to provide a low latency wireless audio connection with practically zero lag.

Bowers & Wilkins Pi6 Wireless Earbuds

$129.97 $249.00 48% off

Starting at $129.97 (was $249), the Bowers & Wilkins Pi6 Wireless Earbuds look great with a sharp design and comfortable fit that come in four colors: storm grey (pictured above), forest green, cloud grey and glacier blue. The earbuds have a great level of performance with detailed and rich sound, and deep and rumbling bass. They perform very well with phone calls too.

Sony SS-CS5M2 Hi-Res Bookshelf Speakers

pair

$153.00 $279.99 45% off

The Sony SS-CS5M2 Hi-Res Bookshelf Speakers , which are on sale for $153 (was $279.99), are an all-around three-way and three-driver system pair that feature high-resolution audio. It’s best for AV receivers and turntables. At 45% off, this is the cheapest price we’ve ever seen on this speaker pair.

Sony WF-1000XM5 Noise-Canceling Wireless Earbuds

$179.99 $329.99 45% off

Sony has raised the noise-cancelation game with the WF-1000XM5 Wireless Earbuds , which are on sale for $179.99 (was $329.99) on Amazon — the all-time lowest price ever. They feature adaptive audio controls to deliver an intimate listening experience with up to 24 hours of battery life when used with their charging case. The earbuds even support high-res audio listening.

Bose QuietComfort Wireless Headphones

second generation

$199.00 $359.00 45% off

Marked down to $199 (was $359) and the lowest price on this model on Amazon, the Bose QuietComfort Headphones (second generation) are new for 2026 with premium audio, world-class noise cancelation and a comfortable fit. They are even stylish with three colors on sale for Black Friday, including hazelnut taupe (pictured above), dewdrop mint and eucalyptus green.

Bang & Olufsen Beosound Explore Speaker

$224.00 $299.00 25% off

The Bang & Olufsen Beosound Explore is a tough and durable Bluetooth speaker, while it pumps out rich, robust and crystal clear audio. It comes in five colors, including bonfire orange (pictured above), black anthracite, green and grey mist. The wireless speaker is on sale for $225 (was $199).

Sony PS-LX3BT Wireless Bluetooth Turntable

$238.00 $398.00 40% off

On sale for $238 (was $398), the Sony PS-LX3BT Wireless Bluetooth Turntable features a sleek and minimalist design that runs quiet, but produces audio that’s rich and detailed. It’s built to last, thanks to premium components, like an aluminum die-cast platter and vibration-dampening isolation feet. It’s refreshingly simple, the design looks great in any space. At 40% off the list price, this is the cheapest price we’ve ever seen on this turntable model.

Samsung Music Frame

$247.99 $397.99 38% off

The Samsung Music Frame , which is on sale for $247.99 (was $397.99) on Amazon, makes home audio look as good and premium as it sounds. It’s designed to seamlessly blend into home decor, while the speaker contains two woofers, two tweeters and two midrange drivers that creates a depth of sound, especially for medium- and larger-sized rooms. It can also be used as a stylish picture frame too.

Sonos Beam

$339.00 $499.00 32% off

For a sleek and compact design, the Sonos Beam is specifically made to amplify dialogue with crystal clear and robust audio. It has sleek curves with multiple speakers on all sides to give it a unique and fresh look, while ensuring sound reverberates throughout the listening space, thanks to Dolby Atmos.
